reason: The plugin is primarily a conversation utility for DSH users, adding a UI setting and configuration-backed behavior switch to choose Chinese or English responses, with a small helper tool to read the active language setting.

summaries.zh: 这是一个 DeepSeek Harness 插件，用于在设置中切换中文/英文对话语言，并可查询当前已设置的会话语言。
summaries.en: This is a DeepSeek Harness plugin that allows users to switch conversation language between Chinese and English in settings and retrieve the currently selected language.

capabilities: Provide a user-facing setting to switch conversation language between Chinese and English in the DSH interface
Store selected language in plugin settings (settings namespace and settings.yaml persistence)
Dynamically adapt assistant persona/system prompt to match the selected conversation language
Expose a local tool (`get_conversation_language`) to return the current language setting
